pnpm.//: pnpm 10 refuses to run a dependency's install scripts unless it is named here, and in CI that refusal is exit code 1 rather than a warning — which is what turned the first real build:frontend red. Both entries are load-bearing: sharp is Next's image optimiser, unrs-resolver is eslint-config-next's module resolver. Locally the failure is invisible because an approval is cached outside the repo, so this list is the only thing that makes the two agree.
